objective: Execute a finite conditional common-temperature-input comparison of exact radiation-stress inference and the linear temperature-to-moment adapter; report physical-target coverage and width, together with response-preserving0/2/4 compression. conventions.metric: (-,+,+,+); U.U=-c²; outward sky n, photon propagation e=-n.
conventions.intensity: Physical bolometric energy density per solid angle I=C_gamma*T_E^4, C_gamma=pi*k_B^4/(60*hbar^3*c^3); spectral radiance must be divided by c before integrating. Dimensionless computation normalized by I_ref=C_gamma*T_ref^4, T_ref=2.7255 K; physical rho_ref=4*pi*I_ref.
conventions.moments: Use spherical-average quadrature weights summing1. rho/rho_ref=<t^4>; q/(c*rho_ref)=-<t^4*n>; pi/rho_ref=<t^4*STF(nn)>; t=T_E/T_ref. Thus f=q/(c*rho), P=pi/rho. Retain signed3+5 coordinates, rho and all cross covariance.
conventions.stress_targets: D=P-g(f), g(f)=3*STF(ff^T)/(2+sqrt(4-3*f.f)); A_gamma=||p_L-rho_L/3||_2/rho_L on unique timelike Landau branch of T*eta. D is observer-frame STF tensor; A_gamma is invariant. Compare both methods against these SAME exact targets.

truth_scenarios.ordered_cases: Cartesian order a in[0,2e-5,0.02], then b in[0.00123,0.3], six cases total. beta=b*(0.6,0,0.8); intrinsic axis is z. No parameter fitting.
truth_scenarios.source: These a and beta ranges are retained stress_code examples. Noise scales below borrow numerical magnitudes from its declared eps_f/eps_P only; the old deterministic ball is NOT relabeled Gaussian confidence.
truth_scenarios.rest_brightness: I_rest/I_ref=1+a*P2(n_rest,z), P2(x)=(3*x²-1)/2. Positive for all six cases. Rest tensor/rho_ref=diag(1,1/3-a/15,1/3-a/15,1/3+2a/15).
truth_scenarios.full_temperature_observation: Let L(beta) be the positive-offdiagonal Lorentz matrix in stress_code. For each lab propagation direction e=-n, form p_rest=L(-beta)*(1,e), E_rest=p_rest[0], n_rest=-p_rest[1:]/E_rest. Exact t_true(n)=[1+a*P2(n_rest,z)]^(1/4)/E_rest. This specifies a positive complete temperature sky with genuine higher modes; it is not reconstructed from8 f/P numbers.
truth_scenarios.analytic_target: T_true=L(beta)*T_rest*L(beta)^T. A_gamma,true=sqrt(6)*abs(a)/15; derive D_true from this tensor. Full-temperature quadrature must reproduce it before MC.
truth_scenarios.temperature_chart: Compute tbar=<t_true>, Theta_true=t_true/tbar-1, d_true=3<Theta_true*n>, Q_true=(15/2)<Theta_true*STF(nn)>. Higher temperature modes and monopole are fixed noiseless known parts of this synthetic experiment; this limitation must be visible.

shared_working_error_law.correlation: R=0.8*I8+0.2*s*s^T, s=(1,-1,1,1,-1,1,-1,1). Diagonal1; eigenvalues0.8 and2.4, strictly PD. C_theta=diag(sigma)*R*diag(sigma). This is an authored measurement law, not observed CMB noise.
shared_working_error_law.draw: eta~N8(0,C_theta). Theta_y(n)=Theta_true(n)+eta_d.n+sum_A eta_QA*n^T E_A n. t_y=tbar*(1+Theta_y). Both methods receive the same t_y and same eta. Never draw f and P independently or reverse-engineer temperature multipoles from an8D moment law.
shared_working_error_law.full_fP_covariance: For each method and case retain calibration-sample mean and full8x8 covariance of(f_x,f_y,f_z,P_E1,...,P_E5), including all3x5 cross blocks. Primary confidence construction propagates these JOINT samples, not independent marginals or a Gaussian approximation to derived moments. Report covariance eigenvalues and standardized cross blocks; covariance alone is not a complete nonlinear law.

methods.exact: Compute I_y/I_ref=t_y^4, then exact rho,f,P,D,A_gamma from joint moments and physical Landau branch.
methods.linear_temperature_adapter: Use the SAME noisy sky: d_y=d_true+eta_d, Q_y=Q_true+sum eta_QA E_A. Linear moment approximation f_lin=-4*d_y/3, P_lin=8*Q_y/15, rho_lin/rho_ref=tbar^4. Assemble T_lin=rho_lin*[[1,f_lin^T],[f_lin,I3/3+P_lin]]. Apply the SAME exact D and Landau readout to T_lin. This isolates linear temperature-to-moment approximation; it is not a straw-man comparison of observer quadrupole norm with a rest-frame quantity.
methods.optional_diagnostic: ||P_lin|| may be shown only as an observer-stress proxy, never labeled A_gamma. No additional competitor, tuned bias subtraction or fitted noise inflation.

domain_handling.temperature: Certify t_y>0 globally using min(t_true)/tbar >= (1-a/2)^(1/4)/(gamma*(1+b)*tbar) and perturbation bound||eta_d||+sqrt(2/3)||eta_Q||_2. If this sufficient certificate fails, mark positivity unverified; do not resample/clip or silently use the fourth power of a negative temperature.
domain_handling.moment_cone: Require rho>0, finite symmetric traceless P, |f|<1 and moment matrix[[1,f^T],[f,I/3+P]] PSD within64*eps*4*matrix_norm roundoff. Exact positive-temperature sky supplies a positive measure; the linear moment matrix gets its own check. No projected repair to the cone.
domain_handling.Landau: Use normalized real eigenvectors of T*eta; require one eigenvector with Minkowski norm<-1e-8 times Euclidean norm², real eigenvalues to1e-12*||T||, positive rho_L and nonnegative rest pressures within roundoff. Preserve ambiguous/nonphysical/branch-failed samples as failures.
domain_handling.invalid_samples: No rejection/resampling. Calibration invalidity holds calibration for that method/case; retain exact method and other cases. Test invalidity remains in the full denominator as operational noncoverage; width NA, invalid fraction reported. Conditional-valid-only summaries may be secondary with their denominator explicit. Do not count invalid intervals as zero-width success.

MC_design.rng: NumPy PCG64; SeedSequence(2026102705).spawn(12), case i uses child2i calibration and2i+1 test. Same eta for exact and linear within case, disjoint calibration/test streams.
MC_design.scope: Pointwise oracle noise-propagation benchmark around each known synthetic temperature sky, NOT a deployable confidence procedure for unknown empirical sky. Both methods follow the same calibration rule around their OWN noiseless method response; do not remove the linear method physical-target bias.
MC_design.D_set: For method m, compute noiseless D_m0. Sort calibration r_j=||D_m(y_j)-D_m0||F; choose1-based k=ceil(0.95*(M+1))=7783. For each independent test sky report the5D ball centered D_m(y) with radius r_(k). Coverage primary: exact D_true lies in that ball. Method-target coverage D_m0 is a calibration diagnostic. D-width=2*r_(k), not a chi-square ellipsoid.
MC_design.A_interval: For method m, compute A_m0 and calibration e_j=A_m(y_j)-A_m0. Sort; use1-based k_lo=floor(.025*(M+1))=204, k_hi=ceil(.975*(M+1))=7988. Test interval=[A_m(y)-e_(k_hi), A_m(y)-e_(k_lo)] intersect[0,infinity). If upper<0, interval is EMPTY, not[0,0]. Record empty rate. Coverage primary uses exact A_true; method-target A_m0 is separate. Do not subtract A_m0-A_true from observed output.
MC_design.finite_MC_intervals: Each test coverage count/N has an exact95% Clopper-Pearson binomial interval, conditional on frozen calibration draws. Calibration-content uncertainty for continuous errors: D content~Beta(k,M+1-k); A equal-tail content~Beta(k_hi-k_lo,M+1-(k_hi-k_lo)); report central95% intervals from those laws. Ties must be counted/reported; do not claim exact continuous-order law if material ties arise.
MC_design.accuracy: N=4096 targets worst-case coverage interval halfwidth about0.016; report actual halfwidth. Calibration finite-sample uncertainty remains separate. No adaptive seeds or additional MC to obtain a preferred verdict. Treat statistically surprising exact-method coverage as a diagnostic requiring raw evidence, not automatic permission to tune.
MC_design.width_summary: For A: empty fraction plus mean/median and5/95 percentiles of nonempty widths, with denominator. Also report unconditional finite-interval width with empties assigned0 only if explicitly labeled and never used alone to rank methods. Paired mean-width difference uses common test skies; report empirical Monte Carlo SE. A narrower interval with failed physical-target coverage is not an improvement.
MC_design.reported_bias: Noiseless and empirical signed D bias, A bias, covariance, physical-target coverage, method-target coverage, width and invalid/empty rates for all six cases. Outcome may favor either method; no required direction of improvement.
